description: This file defines the FormatWithLocationId class, which implements the ValueFormatter interface to format location-related data by ID within the OrangeHRM system. It retrieves location information from the LocationService and returns the location name for a given location ID.

classes.name: FormatWithLocationId
classes.description: Implements formatting of location data by ID using LocationService; retrieves and returns the location name if available.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the Location object by ID and returns its name, or null if not found.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.
